vigil-fear.name: The Watch
vigil-fear.premise: Your believers are points of light and the dark presses in from every side.
vigil-fear.loop: You hold a shadow-shield over one cluster at a time while the dark gnaws at every unshielded light. Coverage is the shield's own shadow; the pressure visibly shifts, and you drag your protection between clusters knowing the rest are burning down.
vigil-fear.signals: A shielded cluster sits in your cast shadow and burns steady; an unshielded cluster gutters, dims, and greys — the flame height itself is the state.
vigil-fear.outcome_win: Dawn arrives with the clusters you chose still burning.
vigil-fear.outcome_fail: The lights you abandoned are grey by morning, standing exactly where you left them.
vigil-fear.why_fun: Triage under guaranteed loss — the skill is deciding what to lose, and living with it.
vigil-fear.pattern_source: Triage — protect what you can; Diegetic state display
vigil-fear.gdd_quote: You shield what you can and you cannot shield everything

holding-hope.name: The Procession
holding-hope.premise: A rooted settlement resists you everywhere but along your own roads.
holding-hope.loop: You walk your road toward the heart and converts fall in behind you, one by one. The line holds only while your pace stays slow and your turns stay wide; move too fast or cut too sharply and the tail detaches where you rushed. Whoever is still with you at the heart converts a resident.
holding-hope.signals: The line of followers IS the state — its length, its gaps, and the stragglers left standing where the line broke.
holding-hope.outcome_win: The unbroken line reaches the heart; residents step out and kneel.
holding-hope.outcome_fail: The line breaks; whoever you dropped stands where you lost them, and the settlement's doors close.
holding-hope.why_fun: The leader's restraint is the skill — the whole tension is between the pace you want and the pace the line can hold.
holding-hope.gdd_quote: the line breaks if you move too fast or turn too sharply

holding-fear.name: The Breaking (v2)
holding-fear.premise: The settlement's resistance shows as a ring around it, thick where belief runs deep.
holding-fear.loop: Strike the ring where it is thinnest; each strike hardens the arcs beside it. Find the collapsing sequence before your stamina runs out.
holding-fear.signals: Arc strength reads as the ring's thickness and glow; a struck arc cracks; hardened arcs brighten.
holding-fear.outcome_win: The ring collapses and the settlement lies open; the town pays you in gold coins.
holding-fear.outcome_fail: Stamina spent, the ring reseals thicker than before.
holding-fear.why_fun: A sequencing puzzle wearing an action skin.
